title: CVPR 2018: Learning to See in the Dark
summary: A short video accompanying the CVPR 2018 paper Learning to See in the Dark. It shows a neural network producing sharp images from very low-light raw sensor data, compared against denoising approaches.
why: HN commenters flag it as a remarkable machine-learning result, notably for showing that training on raw images beats JPEG.

quote.text: Remarkable machine learning result for "producing astoundingly sharp photos in very low light
